notes: §2002:14.8.44.3 GR2: a zero-length identifier-1 ends the UNSTRING at once. The golden reaches it with an ANY LENGTH formal bound BY CONTENT to an OCCURS DEPENDING group whose DEPENDING ON item is 0: §2002:13.16.2.3 GR1 a) makes the formal zero-length, and §2002:14.7.1.1 makes an OCCURS DEPENDING group passed by content take the length its OCCURS clause gives a sending item (BY REFERENCE it takes the maximum, 5, which the third leg shows). Receivers, pointer and tally are untouched (P=01 T=0). kb/Work PB5621 re-probed: the reported maximum length for a by-reference argument is the standard's rule, not a defect.
